verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to deep space in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2: 'the first time humans will travel that far into space since 1972'; R5: 'for the first time in over 50 years'; R6: 'venture beyond low Earth orbit in more than 50 years'; R7: 'returned humans to the moon for the first time since the Apollo program over 50 years ago'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state it is the first crewed deep space/moon mission since 1972, which is over 50 years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II validates the Orion spacecraft life support systems with astronauts aboard.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board'; R6: 'test life-support'; R7: 'tested the spacecraft's life support systems'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly mention validating/testing Orion's life support systems with crew aboard.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day NASA mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources describe it as a 10-day mission; R4 specifies 9 days 1 hour 32 minutes, but 10-day is the common direct description.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will fly farther than any human before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'break Apollo 13’s record ... farthest distance humans have traveled'; R6: 'travel farther from Earth than any humans have before'; R7: 'taken humans farther from Earth than they've ever been, breaking a record set by Apollo 13'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm breaking previous human distance records.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first full-up test of NASA's deep-space navigation systems while human crew are aboard.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'first full-up test of NASA's deep-space exploration system with astronauts onboard ... Guidance, navigation, and communications'
verifications.reasoning: R6 uses exact phrasing 'first full-up test' including navigation with crew.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first full-up test of NASA's deep-space propulsion systems while human crew are aboard.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R6: 'first full-up test of NASA's deep-space exploration system ... Spacecraft and system performance'
verifications.reasoning: R6 mentions 'first full-up test' of systems including performance, but does not specifically name propulsion systems.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first full-up test of NASA's deep-space life support systems while human crew are aboard.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board'; R6: 'first full-up test ... Crew interfaces and habitability ... test life-support'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm testing life support with crew; R6 'full-up test' encompasses it as first with humans.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission aims to break previous distance records for human travel from Earth.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'anticipated to break Apollo 13’s record for the farthest distance'; R6: 'farthest from Earth than any humans have before'; R7: 'breaking a record set by Apollo 13'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements about breaking distance records.

verifications.claim: Artemis II represents the first time humans have traveled toward the Moon since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2: 'first time humans will travel that far into space since 1972'; R5: 'to the vicinity of the Moon for the first time in over 50 years'; R6: 'first mission to carry humans toward the moon since ... 1972'; R7: 'returned humans to the moon ... since the Apollo program over 50 years ago'
verifications.reasoning: Consistent across sources as first since 1972.

verifications.claim: Artemis II includes Jeremy Hansen, the first Canadian astronaut to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2: 'Jeremy Hansen ... first non-American to journey beyond low Earth orbit'; R5: 'first Canadian to go to the Moon'; R6: 'first Canadian to travel to the vicinity of the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Hansen as first Canadian/non-American beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources list Wiseman as Commander.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources list Glover as Pilot.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen
verifications.label: CLEAR
